svg.title: An illustrated AzureCAF delivery loop
svg.desc: Clients and local agents, Copilot cloud agent, and scheduled agentic workflows feed shared issues and pull requests. CI and Repo Status inform maintainers, who decide what to release. GitHub security checks span the process. Release feedback informs future maintenance.
